headline: Penguins could be significant sellers at Trade Deadline
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Penguins general manager Kyle Dubas has plenty of impactful veterans he could sell at the trade deadline for future assets, and that Pittsburgh could be a significant seller.

Our numbers show a team that's been better than its 7-10-2 record. So far this season, PIT has 49% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality, so this is roughly an even split of the good looks). At five-on-five that rises to 52%, which means they've been slightly ahead in a normal game. The gap is in finishing: PIT has scored 4.8 fewer goals than its chances would suggest, while goaltending has been about neutral, at 0.1 goals saved above expected. That points to a team losing games on shot conversion, not one that's being badly outplayed. The sample is only 19 games, so a selling stance may be a bet on the standings more than on the underlying play, and it will matter how much the veterans' value holds if the finishing returns to normal.
